motivation: The single continuous mask and continuous minimum differ both in panel reweighting and in the family of restored columns. Separate them on the same candidate, metric function, row, predictor and tie rule. Add this after the first ten-task analysis and before opening any outcomes of the six higher-dimensional sources.
four_cells: Nominate by the continuous tolerance slack on {empty restoration, all separating restorations} crossed with {the original panel, the third-largest of four panel slacks}. Compute a panel slack by the minimum normalized margin over the fixed metrics. Take the minimum over the chosen restorations; take the largest candidate score. Resolve score ties by the common Gain priority. The two diagonal cells reproduce the original point and slack arms. Each nominee then receives the identical single candidate guard. Freeze nominees before opening the wider panel outcomes.
reporting: Score both off-diagonal cells against complete-slate refits already planned, without extra selection by outer outcomes. Show eligible nominations, realized U, breaches and the paired factorial changes to U and breach rates at the original 3 percent criterion. Count interactions only on this prespecified slate, not as general causal effects. Report primary first and wide cohorts separately. Include global uncertainty and per-task results.
